payload.description:
As a Chatticus user, I want the product workspace to feel like the same living organization introduced on the marketing site, so that named teammates, current work, and approval boundaries are easy to understand at a glance.

Feature: Branded teammate workspace

  Scenario: A user recognizes teammate presence and state
    Given the user opens app.chattic.us
    When the roster and workspace load
    Then each named teammate has a Vultus avatar
    And the selected teammate has a clear role and presence
    And thinking, tool use, speaking, completion, and failure remain distinguishable in text and motion

  Scenario: A user focuses on conversation and work
    Given the app has loaded a roster
    When the user selects a teammate
    Then chat is the primary work surface
    And household tasks remain available without competing with the active conversation
    And control-plane diagnostics are presented as secondary status

  Scenario: A user accesses the workspace on a small or reduced-motion display
    Given the user uses a phone or prefers reduced motion
    When the workspace loads
    Then all interactive controls remain reachable and legible
    And focus states are visible
    And no essential state is communicated only by color or animation.
payload.title: Carry the Chatticus identity into the teammate workspace
